purpose: Audit stale artifacts and harden the kernel, hardware, build, and source-repository authority boundaries without promoting a release or deleting lineage.

canonical_anchor.head_message: doctrine: stage proposed KAI 9000 seal mutation audit

classes.CROWNED_CURRENT: Current authority. May be changed only by an explicitly authorized superseding crown.
classes.ACTIVE_CANONICAL: Current code/config/instruction surface. Drift must be fixed or explicitly marked compatibility debt.
classes.PROPOSED: Reviewable candidate with zero automatic authority.
classes.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: Immutable lineage/evidence. Never silently rewritten to look current.
classes.LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY: May remain for compatibility but cannot outrank current authority.
classes.TEST_HARNESS_ONLY: May validate behavior but cannot become production donor/runtime dependency.
classes.QUARANTINED: Not promotable until provenance, license, security and relevance gates pass.
classes.STALE_BLOCKER: Conflicts with current authority in an active path and must be reconciled before promotion.

rules: Do not mass-delete historical or legacy artifacts.
Classify first, sever active dependencies second, prove replacement third, retire last.
Historical filenames may keep ULTIMA or other retired vocabulary for lineage.
Active agents and workflows must not interpret retired ritual names as authority.
A proposal cannot supersede a crown by location, filename, recency, or AI confidence.
No stale artifact cleanup may rewrite cryptographic build receipts or physical-device evidence.

audit_findings.title: Current source-contract crown is explicit
audit_findings.finding: The M1 signed secure WebView/socket source contract and Project Hydra directory crown are present under the crowned source-of-truth lane.

audit_findings.title: Copilot instructions contain a stale release baseline
audit_findings.finding: The active instructions still hard-code Crown Gate 1.0.5 as the last sealed build baseline and require a legacy lumh-os doctrine read.
audit_findings.resolution: Resolve release/build truth dynamically from the latest crown and exact build receipts; move legacy lumh-os/ULTIMA material to compatibility-only context.

audit_findings.title: Project manifest contains historical distribution goals presented as current goals
audit_findings.finding: IzzyOnDroid/public distribution fields, baseline version codes 100/101, and other older release targets remain in the active project manifest.
audit_findings.resolution: Do not delete them in this pass. Mark them audit debt and require a separately reviewed manifest reconciliation before any publication decision.

audit_findings.title: SM-X400 rooted goal conflicts with current private hardware role
audit_findings.finding: The current private hardware doctrine treats SM-X400 as a stock/unrooted art cockpit and QA lane unless fresh device proof says otherwise.
audit_findings.resolution: Classify the rooted goal as a noncanonical lab proposal requiring fresh physical proof and explicit mutation before use.

audit_findings.title: ULTIMA-era artifacts remain widespread
audit_findings.finding: Retired ritual vocabulary remains in historical scripts, workflows, docs and manifests.
audit_findings.resolution: Preserve lineage, but block active canonical instructions from depending on or emitting those names as execution authority.

audit_findings.title: Legacy lumh-os/kai9000 tree still carries incompatible routing metadata
audit_findings.finding: Legacy manifests may name a different branch or older provider-routing assumptions.
audit_findings.resolution: Treat as compatibility/migration source only until each required behavior is intentionally absorbed into Project Hydra.

audit_findings.title: Chrome Dev/Canary remains harness-only
audit_findings.finding: The harness may test behavior but must not provide donor code or runtime dependency to production APKs.

audit_findings.title: Canonical branch protection/signing debt
audit_findings.finding: The current luhmos-main branch is not protected and the observed head commit is unsigned.
audit_findings.resolution: Track as repository hardening debt. Do not confuse Git commit signing with APK release signing, and do not silently change repository administration in this proposal.

audit_findings.title: Repository default-branch activity must not override luhmos-main
audit_findings.finding: Repository-wide searches can surface newer commits from another/default branch.
audit_findings.resolution: All current-source reads and mutations must explicitly resolve luhmos-main unless a later crown changes branch authority.

audit_findings.title: Local-first inference must not silently replace OpenAI-primary agent doctrine
audit_findings.finding: Local Ollama is valuable for eligible private/offline inference, but global assistant authority and project reasoning remain governed by the current OpenAI/Lum doctrine unless explicitly mutated.
audit_findings.resolution: Use task-level routing: ChatGPT/OpenAI primary for project reasoning; deterministic local policy first for validation; Ollama optional for bounded local inference; no silent provider failover.

audit_findings.title: M1 is source-contract green, not runtime/release/device green
audit_findings.finding: Typed Kotlin bridge, headless broker, rejection tests, signed build, signer proof, physical Samsung proof and live reconnect/reboot evidence remain separate gates.
audit_findings.resolution: Never promote a later proof state from an earlier one.

control_kernel.role: deterministic policy, typed routing, validation, evidence and bounded tool dispatch

hardware.sm_x400_role: stock/unrooted art cockpit and QA unless fresh proof plus explicit mutation says otherwise

repo_hardening_actions_in_revision_2: Update active Copilot instructions to resolve authority from crowned Project Hydra paths rather than legacy ULTIMA doctrine.
Remove the hard-coded 1.0.5 release-baseline claim from active agent instructions.
Add an explicit KERNEL/HARDWARE/BUILD/SOURCE boundary contract.
Add a stale-artifact registry that classifies legacy material without deleting it.
Add a report-only stale-artifact audit tool with strict mode for structural blockers.
Keep proposal material outside the crowned source-of-truth directory.
Upload this exact AI JSON proposal to the private proposed source-of-truth Drive lane.
